mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_case_classification(case_classification_id, case_id, industry_code, mcc_code, primary_slot, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, create_time) VALUES(#{row.caseClassificationId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.industryCode}, #{row.mccCode}, #{row.primarySlot}, #{row.confirmedBy}, #{row.confirmedTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT case_classification_id AS caseClassificationId, case_id AS caseId, industry_code AS industryCode, mcc_code AS mccCode, primary_slot AS primarySlot, confirmed_by AS confirmedBy, confirmed_time AS confirmedTime, create_time AS createTime FROM t_dd_case_classification WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY case_classification_id
